event: The old woman jerks aside, quicker than any sixty-year-old. The braid scorches the charcoal mound.
Her kind face goes flat. A gray shield shimmers up around her, and she whistles, sharp.

memory.fact: Struck, she raises her shield, whistles up her wolves, and answers with blight bolts and rot mist.
